## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and both Financials and Industrials are negative; leadership is narrow and concentrated in Energy/Materials.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 from 2 sectors).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology weak: GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -21.75% | 1M: -39.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY; EOG (1W: +7.81% | 1M: +23.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Narrow (3 Energy / 2 Materials).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -21.75% | 1M: -39.73%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -9.94% | 1M: -9.05%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: -9.78% | 1M: -1.59%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology and high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND—all cyclical Energy/Materials momentum; watch FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is under pressure with broad weakness; GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology: 6/24 positive (internal rotation toward lower participation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are weak overall: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -5.93%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Financials: 5/20 positive (sector weakness).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed to soft: JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -14.07%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare: 5/17 positive (defensive names showing isolated strength).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to cyclical Energy/Materials names showing clear 1W strength and ABOVE TREND action (XOM, SLB, DOW, MPC) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech that is BELOW TREND (MSFT, GOOGL, META). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth given narrow cyclical leadership and weak tech breadth; monitor for trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Energy: 8/10 positive) — strong 1W momentum and multiple ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Technology (Technology: 6/24 positive) — broad selling and concentrated weakness in mega-cap names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
XOM 1M hold/support (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND—break below recent swing low would signal loss of momentum; NVDA resistance at recent breakdown levels (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND; EL downside momentum (1W: -21.75% | 1M: -39.73%) BELOW TREND—watch for further liquidation or takeover speculation reversal.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY — FDA approval headline confirming and price showing short-term follow-through. NVDA (+55 overall mixed): NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines present but price is falling (divergence). EL (+55): EL (1W: -21.75% | 1M: -39.73%) BELOW TREND — bullish talk of strategic talks but price is selling off (distribution).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PANW (-55): PANW (1W: -9.78% | 1M: -1.59%) BELOW TREND — negative AI/framing headlines confirmed by sharp 1W drop. ORCL (-45): ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND — dividend/headline risk confirming downside. UNH (-45): UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND — legal/breakup headlines amplify existing weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with Value/Cyclical tilt as Energy/Materials lead and breadth at 3/11; Financials and Industrials are negative confirming the defensive regime. XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND and SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND show tech stress. Key risk: major divergence (AAPL, INTU, JNJ showing 1W/1M opposite signals) and mixed news flow (NVDA/EL headlines vs falling prices) — watch for trend confirmation before adding to core exposure.
